You are designing a tiny icon/badge that represents a software project plan. It will be shown as small as 24x24 pixels in a list and as large as 128px on a header, so it must be BOLD and LEGIBLE at 24px — a single recognizable subject, not fine detail or text.

Art direction: Bold and confident: one saturated background color with a light foreground glyph, clean thick strokes. The badge should read as a distinct sticker.

Draw the plan's SUBJECT as simple geometric line/shape art. Do NOT put letters, words, or a monogram in the icon. Avoid thin lines, small gaps, and more than ~3 distinct elements — they collapse into mush at 24px.

Output requirements (STRICT):
- Output ONLY a single complete <svg>...</svg> element. No markdown fences, no prose, no explanation.
- The root <svg> MUST use viewBox="0 0 100 100" and MUST declare xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg".
- Self-contained: no external references, no <image>, no <script>, no external fonts.

Plan title: Deep Clones
Plan description: Clone git repos fast so a new agent pod starts working in seconds.
